cover: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: children's picture book cover artwork, landscape 3:2. Create an original warm, beautifully composed cut-paper and colored-pencil illustration for ages 5–7, with visible paper grain, rounded simple shapes, gentle expressive faces, generous cream negative space. A six-year-old South Asian girl Maya, warm brown skin, dark curly bob, mustard yellow dungarees over a teal short-sleeved shirt, holds a paper picture of a blue whale under a yellow star. Beside her floats Pip, a small teal square envelope-shaped story character with two dot eyes and tiny feet. They look into a miniature modern data center shown as a friendly cutaway building: orderly navy-blue racks of servers with small lights, tidy cables, fans, plants outside, an adult woman engineer in coral shirt visible inside. A ribbon path leads from the child's tablet through the building toward a distant cozy house. Palette warm ivory, ink navy, teal, coral, sunny mustard. Tender curiosity, afternoon light; crafted editorial picture-book art, not slick 3D, not corporate infographic. No text, lettering, logos, watermark or UI. No literal cloud containing computers, no padlock floating in the sky. This is artwork only; title will be added separately. Fill a landscape frame with an uncluttered balanced scene.
